$description: Hand-written. How each semantic --sv-* custom property of version 0.2 (dist/tokens.css) is re-pointed at a V2 token (ds-tokens/dist/tokens.css) so that 0.2's screens render with V2 values. v2/tools/build-compare.mjs writes v2/screens/bridge.css from this file and fails if a semantic --sv-* property is missing here, if a V2 property named here is missing from either V2 token file, or if a component token no longer follows the semantic token listed. 'why' says which V2 token does the same job and what changes.

mapped.why: The page background behind panels. V2's secondary surface is the off-white page tone in light. In dark V2 makes secondary (#242528) lighter than primary (#18191a), so panels sit darker than the page in dark, the opposite of 0.2. Kept as the lead specified; the inversion is V2's own choice.
The surface of a card or panel. V2's primary surface is the main content surface (white in light).
The recessed fill inside a field, select or message on a panel. 0.2 sets it equal to the ground in both themes; mapping it to the same V2 token keeps that relation.
Body and heading text.
Hints, details and secondary lines.

The border of a control (field, select, checkbox, secondary button), which must reach 3 to 1. V2's strong border is the border meant to be seen; primary border is a divider and too faint for a control.
Hairlines between list rows and around panels, which need not reach 3 to 1.
The one solid action colour (the primary button). V2's primary interactive fill is the pink brand action colour.
Text and marks drawn on a solid accent or status fill.
The focus outline. V2 has a dedicated focus border colour (blue).

The cost summary's inverted surface (dark in light, light in dark). V2 has no inverse surface; the only themed fill that flips like this and pairs with text-inverse is interactive-neutral (black in light, white in dark). It is an interactive fill borrowed for a surface: a gap V2 should fill with a surface-inverse token.
Text on the inverted surface. V2's text-inverse flips with the theme, as 0.2's does.
The error fill: status mark behind a white glyph, the error edge on a field and the error summary's tab. V2's error interactive fill is the solid red meant to carry white.
The warning status mark fill behind a white glyph.
The success status mark fill behind a white glyph.
The neutral status mark fill behind a white glyph. V2's bold neutral accent surface is the grey fill made to carry white text.
4px. Static spacing, because 0.2's spacing never changes with density.
8px, same value.
12px, same value.
16px, same value.
20px, same value.
32px, same value.
Corner of a control. V2 ties a control's radius to its height, and the bridged control is 44px tall (see --sv-size-control), so 12px becomes 8px.
Corner of a panel. V2's largest container radius, 16px, is the nearest to 0.2's 20px.
Small corner of the error summary's tab. 6px, same value; V2 gives small elements 6px.
The one typeface: Geist in V2, with the system stack after it.
Body text. 16px, same value. V2's body-base is 14px, which is below 0.2's 16px minimum for text, so the 16px V2 body size is used.
Section headings (h2). 20px, same value.
The page title (h1), 24px in 0.2. V2 has 20px and 28px, both 4px away; the tie is broken upward so the title stays larger than section headings.
The cost summary total, 36px in 0.2. V2 has 32px and 40px, both 4px away; the tie is broken upward so the total stays the largest text on the page, as 0.2 requires.
The total when the amount is long. 28px, same value.
Body weight. V2's body weight is 500, so body text becomes a little heavier than 0.2's 400.
0.2 uses one strong weight for headings, labels and bold text. V2 gives headings and emphasis 700 and labels 600; 700 covers two of the three jobs.
Height of a field, select or button. V2's largest control, 44px, is the nearest to 0.2's 48px and still meets 0.2's 44px minimum.
Height of the primary button, 56px in 0.2. V2 has no control taller than 44px, so the primary button loses its extra height.
A mark: the select arrow, the checkbox box and error glyphs. V2's medium icon, 20px, is the nearest to 0.2's 24px.
The status mark. 20px, same value.
1px, same value.
2px, same value: control borders.
Focus outline width. V2 proposes 2px where 0.2 has 3px.
Gap between a control and its focus outline. 2px, same value.
Short state change. V2's fast is 100ms, 0.2's quick is 120ms.

notMapped.why: 0.2 uses a unitless ratio (1.5) that scales with each element's size, and one rule multiplies it by a font size in calc(). V2's line heights are fixed rem values per text size; one fixed value would cramp larger text and make that calc() invalid. 0.2's value stays.
Same reason as the body line height: a unitless ratio (1.2) used on headings of several sizes, where V2 has a fixed rem per size. 0.2's value stays.
Minimum height of a text area (96px). V2 has no text area or multi-line control size. 0.2's value stays.
Width of the error summary's tab and the message's leading band (48px). V2 has no token for a band like this; the nearest size, a 44px control, does a different job. 0.2's value stays.
How far a button moves when pressed (2px). V2 has no motion offset token. 0.2's value stays.
Reading width of the page (544px). V2 has no page or column width; its dialog sizes do a different job. 0.2's value stays.
Width of the two-column layout (1024px). V2 has no layout width token. 0.2's value stays.
The 1px box that hides text from sight but not from screen readers. A technique, not a design value; V2 has no equivalent. 0.2's value stays.
The 4px error edge of a checkbox. V2 has border widths of 1px and 2px only. 0.2's value stays.
One turn of the busy mark (800ms). V2's durations are for state changes (100ms, 160ms), not a repeating loop. 0.2's value stays.

followsNote: Component tokens are not redefined. Each is declared on :root as var() of one semantic token, so it takes the bridged value through that token.
primitivesNote: The --sv-p-* primitives are not mapped: no component reads them (0.2's lint forbids it); they only feed the semantic tokens, which the bridge replaces. Icons (--sv-icon-*) are SVG masks drawn in the current text colour and need no mapping.
accentNote: 0.2's teal accent (data-accent="teal") is not mapped: the bridge sets --sv-color-accent to V2's primary action colour whatever the accent attribute says, because V2 has one brand accent.
